retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered collage combining vintage black-and-white photography, botanical sketches, and hand-drawn scribbles with jagged, custom-lettered display text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex visual assembly featuring overlapping rectangular frames of varying sizes, containing a mix of sepia-toned portraits, botanical illustrations, and a full-length figure leaning against a vertical post, all unified by a desaturated, slightly grainy texture and rough-edged typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping rectangular frames creating a sense of depth
Contrast between sharp photographic elements and soft-edged sketches
Vertical anchor provided by the figure and post on the right third
Text placed in the upper right quadrant against a clear sky background
coreInvariants: Jagged, uneven stroke weights in the lettering
Presence of a botanical element with yellow horizontal stripes
Mix of monochrome and muted color photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man leaning against a post occupies the right third; a child sits in the upper left; various smaller frames cluster in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark vertical post on the far right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right text, moves left to the child, then spirals inward through the central collage elements to the standing figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The pale blue sky in the upper right provides breathing room for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue and off-white sky tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the photographic shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow and green in the botanical illustration
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the black-and-white photo inserts.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness resembling ink on paper
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial capitals with exaggerated descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom-lettered style with varying sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, expressive quality of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of vintage photos and sketches. Include a man leaning on a post on the right, a child in the top left, and a botanical drawing with yellow stripes in the center. Leave the top right sky area clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn, jagged black lettering in the top right sky area, stacked in two lines with an irregular, expressive style.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering jagged and hand-drawn?
Are there multiple overlapping photographic and illustrative frames?
Is the color palette desaturated and nostalgic?
Is the standing figure positioned on the right third?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow accent color
Degree of jaggedness in the typography

mustAchieve: A sense of tactile, physical collage

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite jagged style
Verify the vertical anchor on the right
Confirm the mix of monochrome and color elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine vintage photography with hand-drawn elements and jagged, ink-like typography to create a nostalgic, alternative-rock inspired collage.
